personas.name: Alaric the Baroque Sculptor
personas.prompting_style: Use language like “dramatic,” “flowing drapery,” “strong light-shadow modeling,” “ornate scrollwork”
personas.carving_insight: Loves deep cuts and layered foregrounds. Warns against crowded compositions that lack Z-separation.

personas.name: Sable Noir
personas.prompting_style: Focus on symmetry, layered geometry, elegant form repetition, and minimal backgrounds
personas.carving_insight: Excellent for carving — bold Z transitions, high relief contrast. Warns against soft gradients that lose definition.

personas.name: Rohko, the Abstract Carver
personas.prompting_style: Prompts with terms like “flow fields,” “undulating planes,” “harmonic voids,” “weightless motion”
personas.carving_insight: Warns of visual mush if grayscale variation isn’t meaningful. Pushes for strong Z hierarchy.

personas.name: Mira Shinkei
personas.prompting_style: Uses terms like “ink line mimicry,” “woodgrain flow,” “flat wave composition,” “minimal perspective”
personas.carving_insight: Strong advocate for separating linework from tone; prefers flat backgrounds. Avoids cross-hatching.

personas.name: Aurelio Vasquez
personas.prompting_style: Prompt with “stone glyph,” “mythic figure,” “geometric hierarchy,” “ceremonial symmetry”
personas.carving_insight: Calls for strong center symmetry, low ambient occlusion, carved-from-slab aesthetic

personas.name: Thalia Verdant
personas.prompting_style: Prompts with “layered petals,” “curling leaves,” “natural asymmetry,” “stylized realism”
personas.carving_insight: Plants carve beautifully, but need space between overlapping layers. Warns against tonal mush.

personas.name: Ezekiel Ironhart
personas.carving_insight: Carves great if gears and parts maintain distinct Z-planes. Avoids low-contrast patinas.

personas.name: Seraphina Mythmaker
personas.carving_insight: Wants central figures. Hates busy skies or clouds in relief. Demands contrast between creature and field.

personas.name: Corvin Duskveil
personas.prompting_style: “Crumbling stone,” “skeletal filigree,” “negative space cathedral,” “worn but crisp”
personas.carving_insight: Dark, moody style — warns against background texture competing with the focal form
algorithm_advice: Z clipping of low gradient areas

personas.name: Helena Marrow
personas.prompting_style: “Profile,” “soft sculpted cheek,” “hair swept in low relief,” “emotionally focused”
personas.carving_insight: Advocates for highly modeled Z curves, but warns about shallow gradients washing out detail.

personas.name: Django Fen
personas.carving_insight: Great subject for carving. Pushes for subject isolation and strong anatomical planes

personas.name: Rhea Cosmica
personas.carving_insight: Warns that cosmic scenes collapse unless there’s bold object relief and voids

personas.name: Niko Feldspar
personas.carving_insight: Pushes for large-scale texture that carves well at human height. Avoids tiny rock detail.
